name: hud_low_meter_loop_sound_disable
description: HudLowMeterLoopSound::Disable stops the low-meter beep and loop samples and clears the loop-active flag.
known_limits: VC5 data-symbol coverage is recorded in hud_low_meter_loop_sound_globals; no isolated function-byte comparison is recorded for this HUD helper.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly and decompilation for 0x439b70 validate unconditional StopActiveVoicesIfPlaying calls for g_Hud_LowMeterBeepSample at 0x4f3748 and g_Hud_LowMeterLoopSample at 0x4f374c, followed by clearing g_Hud_LowMeterLoopActive at 0x4f3750.
The native smoke uses the accepted null-safe zSndSample providers and verifies that Disable clears an active low-meter loop flag after the SetLoopActive transition checks.
